commit_message: feat: add retry wrapper around dispatch client

session.text: Add a retry wrapper around the dispatch client. Three attempts, exponential backoff. Keep it isolated to the dispatch package so nothing else is affected.
Adding retry.go with a 3-attempt exponential backoff. This is contained within internal/dispatch and does not touch callers.

diff: +func (c *Client) withRetry(ctx context.Context, fn func() error) error {
+    if err := fn(); err == nil { return nil }

commit_message: fix: propagate retry deadline through hook runner

session.text: The hook runner is timing out. Make the retry deadline visible to it.
Threaded the deadline into hooks/runner.go and emitted it from telemetry/emit.go.

commit_message: chore: drop retry wrapper, move to caller-side backoff

session.text: Remove the retry wrapper. We decided backoff belongs at the caller, not the client.
Deleted retry.go and removed the wrapper from client.go. Callers must now implement their own backoff.

diff: -func (c *Client) withRetry(ctx context.Context, fn func() error) error {
+// callers are responsible for their own backoff

commit_message: feat: empty-repo guard in dispatch generation

session.text: Guard dispatch generation against empty repositories. Also handle the detached HEAD case while you are in there.
Added the empty-repo guard in generate.go. Detached HEAD not covered yet.

diff: +// guard against repositories with no commits yet
+  head, err := repo.Head(); if err != nil { return nil, err }
